import_batches_filename_safe.name: import_batches_filename_safe
import_batches_filename_safe.value:
"import_batches"."filename" <> ''
        and strpos("import_batches"."filename", '/') = 0
        and strpos("import_batches"."filename", chr(92)) = 0
        and "import_batches"."filename" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

import_batches_counts_nonnegative.name: import_batches_counts_nonnegative
import_batches_counts_nonnegative.value:
"import_batches"."row_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."error_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."warning_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."duplicate_review_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."committed_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."skipped_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."reverted_count" >= 0

merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique.name: merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique
merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique.where:
"merge_events"."completed_at" is null
          and "merge_events"."reversed_at" is null
          and "merge_events"."status" in ('planned', 'manual_remediation_required')
